def transform(grid):
    """Decode the repeated marker lattice to the compact color matrix."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Marker positions are at regular row/column intervals; 9 marks empty slots.
    rows = range(7, h, 3)
    cols = range(3, w, 4)
    lattice = [[1 if grid[r][c] == 9 else grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    # A cell gets the color shared by its four corner markers; otherwise background 1.
    return [
        [lattice[i][j]
         if lattice[i][j] == lattice[i + 1][j] == lattice[i][j + 1] == lattice[i + 1][j + 1]
         else 1
         for j in range(len(lattice[0]) - 1)]
        for i in range(len(lattice) - 1)
    ]

    # Decode the small matrix encoded by horizontal colored separators and
    # vertical separator columns. Values sit at row-band/column-band junctions.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # encoded at row boundaries and column boundaries as identical corner digits.
    # Derive cell bands from the thick 5/0 framing pattern.
    rowbands = [1, 8]
    colbands = [1, 27]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in colbands] for r in rowbands]

    # The diagram repeats a background tile with a grid of crossing lines.
